attempts.artifact:
TC-001: Patient generates request and doctor gives diagnosis (positive)
  Precondition: Admin has set up at least one doctor.
  Steps:
    - Patient creates a consultation request.
    - Doctor views the request and provides a diagnosis.
  Expected:
    - Diagnosis is recorded in the system.
    - Patient can view the diagnosis.

TC-002: Patient generates request with no doctor available (negative)
  Precondition: Admin has not set up any doctor.
  Steps:
    - Patient creates a consultation request.
  Expected:
    - System displays error message to patient: "No doctors available for consultation".

TC-003: Prescription sent to patient, chemist, and labs (positive)
  Precondition: Admin has set up at least one doctor, one pharmacy, and one lab.
  Steps:
    - Doctor generates a prescription.
  Expected:
    - Prescription is sent to patient.
    - Prescription is sent to pharmacy.
    - Prescription is sent to lab.

TC-004: Prescription not sent to pharmacy when no pharmacy (negative)
  Precondition: Admin has set up at least one doctor but no pharmacy.
  Steps:
    - Doctor generates a prescription.
  Expected:
    - Prescription is sent to patient.
    - Prescription is sent to lab.
    - Pharmacy is not listed as recipient.

TC-005: Chemist delivers medicine to patient (positive)
  Precondition: Admin has set up pharmacy (prescription sent to pharmacy per TC-003).
  Steps:
    - Chemist uses prescription to deliver medicines to patient.
  Expected:
    - Patient receives medicines.

TC-006: Lab collects specimen and delivers report (positive)
  Precondition: Admin has set up lab.
  Steps:
    - Lab uses prescription to collect specimen from patient and deliver report.
  Expected:
    - Patient receives lab report.
    - Lab report is updated in system for future reference.

TC-007: Lab report not generated when no lab (negative)
  Precondition: Admin has not set up any lab.
  Steps:
    - Doctor generates prescription.
  Expected:
    - Lab report is not generated.
    - System does not attempt specimen collection.

TC-008: Admin sets up specialty (positive)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin sets up specialty (e.g., "Cardiology").
  Expected:
    - Specialty is added to system.

TC-009: Admin sets up duplicate specialty (negative)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin tries to set up specialty with existing name.
  Expected:
    - System rejects input and displays error: "Specialty already exists".

TC-010: Admin adds doctor (positive)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin adds doctor with required fields (name, specialty).
  Expected:
    - Doctor is added to system.

TC-011: Admin adds doctor without name (negative)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin tries to add doctor without name.
  Expected:
    - System rejects input and displays error: "Name is required".

TC-012: Admin adds lab and pharmacy (positive)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin adds lab and pharmacy.
  Expected:
    - Lab is added.
    - Pharmacy is added.

TC-013: Admin adds lab without name (negative)
  Precondition: None.
  Steps:
    - Admin tries to add lab without name.
  Expected:
    - System rejects input and displays error: "Name is required".

TC-014: Admin updates doctor information (positive)
  Precondition: Admin has added a doctor.
  Steps:
    - Admin updates doctor's information (e.g., phone number).
  Expected:
    - Doctor's information is updated in system.

TC-015: Admin deletes doctor with active consultation (negative)
  Precondition: Admin has added a doctor with active consultation.
  Steps:
    - Admin tries to delete the doctor.
  Expected:
    - System rejects deletion and displays error: "Cannot delete doctor with active consultations".
